name: notify-router
description: Rules for Claude Code alerts: when one is worth sending (done, blocked, error, usage limits) and where it goes (chime, macOS notification, ntfy).

doneAfterSeconds.title: Done: minimum turn length (seconds)
doneAfterSeconds.description: Only alert that a turn is done if it took at least this long.

blockedAfterSeconds.title: Blocked: wait before alerting (seconds)
blockedAfterSeconds.description: Alert only if Claude is still waiting on you after this long. 0 alerts at once.

usageThresholds.title: Usage alert thresholds (%)
usageThresholds.description: Alert when the context window or a rate-limit window (5-hour, 7-day) crosses each of these percentages. Comma-separated. Empty = off. Rate limits are only reported on a subscription.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Local time as HH:MM-HH:MM, may wrap past midnight (22:00-07:00). Alerts inside it are dropped. Empty = off.

dedupeSeconds.title: Don't repeat the same alert within (seconds)

includeFolder.title: Include the folder name in alerts
includeFolder.description: Puts the session's folder name in the alert title so you can tell which session needs you. The name is sent to every sink, ntfy.sh included.

sessionLabel.title: Add a short session label to the title
sessionLabel.description: Adds the first 4 characters of the session id (Claude Code: my-project #a1b2) so two sessions in the same folder can be told apart. Sent to every sink, ntfy.sh included.

desktop.title: macOS desktop notification
desktop.description: Send alerts to Notification Center (macOS only).

chime.title: Play a chime
chime.description: Play a short sound with each alert (macOS only). Quiet hours, dedupe and the event filter apply.

chimeOn.title: Events that play the chime
chimeOn.description: Comma-separated: done, blocked, error, usage. Each event has its own sound. Only applies while the chime is on.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Send alerts to this ntfy topic. On the public ntfy.sh the topic name is the only secret: use a long random one. Empty = off.

ntfyServer.title: ntfy server
ntfyServer.description: Base URL of the ntfy server.

ntfyToken.title: ntfy access token
ntfyToken.description: For a protected topic. Empty = none.
